New 7 Brew Locations and Where It's Expanding

7 Brew has 900 open stands across 38 states. We track what the official locator publishes, which means confirmed stands only — so rather than guess at opening dates, this page shows where the chain is thinnest, which states it has not reached, and how to find out about your own town before a stand opens.

A straight answer about "coming soon" lists: 7 Brew does not publish a national pipeline of unopened stands, and neither do we. Any site listing dozens of future 7 Brew addresses with dates is guessing. The checks below are the ones that actually work.

How to tell if a 7 Brew is coming to your town

  1. The official locator. New stands appear on 7brew.com's locator once an opening date is set — typically a few weeks out. That is the only confirmation that counts.
  2. Hiring posts. A stand hires its crew roughly a month before opening, and the job post carries the street address. This is usually the earliest public signal.
  3. Planning and permit filings. City planning agendas list the build long before anything is visible, often six to twelve months ahead. Search your city's portal for "7 Brew" or "Brew Culture".
  4. The build itself. 7 Brew stands go up fast and look alike — a small square building with two drive-thru lanes and a walk-up window on a pad site.

Newest markets: where 7 Brew just arrived

States with only a handful of stands are the ones actively being built out. If you are in one of these, more are likely nearby:

States with no 7 Brew yet

12 states have no stand in the official locator as of 2026-09-21:

Alaska · California · Delaware · Hawaii · Idaho · Maine · Nevada · New Hampshire · Oregon · Rhode Island · Vermont · Washington

The gap is mostly the West Coast and the Northeast. 7 Brew started in Arkansas and has grown outward through the South and Midwest, which is why Texas (126 stands), Florida (57) and Ohio (52) are still well ahead of everywhere else.

New 7 Brew locations FAQ

How do I find out if a 7 Brew is coming to my town?

The official 7 Brew locator is the only source that confirms a stand before it opens — new builds appear there once a date is set. Local planning and permit filings usually show up months earlier, and hiring posts for a stand address are the clearest sign an opening is weeks away.

How many 7 Brew locations are there?

There are 900 open 7 Brew stands across 38 states in the official locator as of 2026-09-21.

Which states have the fewest 7 Brew stands?

Massachusetts (1), Montana (1), Arizona (3), Maryland (3) — these are the newest markets, and the ones most likely to add stands next.

Which states have no 7 Brew yet?

12 states still have no stand in the locator: Alaska, California, Delaware, Hawaii, Idaho, Maine, Nevada, New Hampshire, Oregon, Rhode Island, Vermont, Washington.

Does 7 Brew announce grand openings?

Yes, usually through the stand's own social accounts rather than nationally, and often with a free-drink promotion on opening week. The chain-wide promotion to know about is Jackpot Day on the 7th of each month.
